h:
此工作流程使用图像和预先生成的深度图（已经是黑白的，不需要预处理）制作抽象动画。

然后，可以使用附带的示例 .tox 将这些视频输入 TouchDesigner 中的音频反应设置，从而使这些视频成为音频反应。这使用自动节拍检测来驱动播放的速度。免费的非商业版 TouchDesigner 足以满足此工作流程（唯一的限制是最大分辨率为 1280x1280）

我还提供了 37 个黑白循环供您玩！ （可能需要 QuickTime 7 来播放这些 mov）

o.en:
This workflow makes abstract animations using images and pre-generated depth maps (that are already black and white and don't require preprocessing).

Then these videos can be made audio-reactive by feeding them into the audioreactive setup in TouchDesigner, using the included a sample .tox. This uses automatic beat detection to drive the speed of the palyback of the. The free non-commercial version of TouchDesigner is sufficient for this workflow (only limitation is a maximum resolution of 1280x1280)

I have also included 37 black and white loops to play with! (QuickTime 7 might be needed to play back these mov's)
